goal: Implement the SkillOpt-shaped prepare/evaluate-only optimizer adapter behind the existing exchange: dal optimize prepare builds a sanitized training set from stored run records and emits the skillopt exchange envelope; dal optimize evaluate runs the deterministic bounded-edits validation gate (surface, target, base digest, edit bounds, anchors, reconstructed digest) with no model calls and no application.

acceptance_criteria.statement: optimize prepare emits a schema-valid exchange envelope (provider_hint skillopt, prepare_only, no external transfer) and a sanitized training set with capped episodes carrying failure facts, check deltas, traces, harness pins, and batch linkage.

optimize evaluate validates bounded-edits candidates deterministically: exchange match, skills-only surface, target/base digests, edit count/size clipping, sequential anchor resolution, reconstructed candidate digest; secrets rejected before checks.
Neither half calls a model, sends data, or applies anything; the no-optimizer v0 boundary (optimizer.optimize/apply disabled) stays intact.
Spec DAL-021, README, ROADMAP, requirement evidence updated; capsule digests refreshed; full gate green.

outcome.summary: The SkillOpt-shaped prepare/evaluate-only adapter shipped: deterministic training-set preparation from the trace-populated run store and a bounded-edits validation gate with gradient clipping, anchor resolution, and reconstructed candidate digests — 134 tests green, no model or application path added.

what_worked: The existing optimizer-exchange schema already carried provider_hint skillopt and mode prepare_only, so the adapter filled the contract instead of inventing one.
The validation gate mirrors SkillOpt's clipping and validation semantics with pure string operations: every check is deterministic and testable.
Candidate documents are secret/PII-scanned before any check runs, matching the privacy-before-persistence rule.

Typecheck, build, 134 tests (5 sandbox/docker probes skipped), capsule checks, policy check, v0 suite, and benchmark suite all passed.

uncertainty.statement: The reflect step (optimizer model producing the bounded edits) is not implemented; candidates currently come from humans or a future approval-gated reflect command.
uncertainty.resolution: The next increment adds an approval-bound optimize reflect behind the send_data_externally decision, producing candidates that flow straight into the validation gate.

notes: Deterministic-only feature: no model calls, external transfers, profile changes, or candidate application.
